meta.title: Orchestrator kit
meta.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Settings into a control panel for AI agent teams: route provider, model and reasoning effort for each of the 20 Craft dev-flow roles (repo-scout, planner, implementer, diff-reviewer and 16 more), with fail-closed validation against the live provider catalog, atomic locked writes and per-role inherit defaults. Install via Plugins > Add plugin; configure in Settings > Orchestrator.

roles.arch-advisor: [Discovery & Advisory] Does: read-only senior advisor for hard architecture tradeoffs, contract design, security boundaries, and 2+ debug-failure escalations. / Skip: for trivial edits, single-attempt fixes, or routine lookups.
roles.browser-qa: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Live browser, Web UI, and Windows/desktop QA using Playwright/Chrome DevTools MCP, agent-desktop, and read_image; logs screenshots and checks under .devflow/evidence/. / Skip: source code edits or closing open tabs.
roles.debt-auditor: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Read-only maintainability auditor catching duplication, dead paths, tangled ownership, oversized modules, and stale scaffolding where cleanup ROI exceeds migration cost. / Skip: code edits, cosmetic churn, or trivial cleanups.
roles.debugger: [Planning & Execution] Does: Reproduces failures first, isolates root causes via single-variable hypotheses, applies surgical fixes, and enforces 3-Strike escalation. / Skip: Greenfield features.
roles.diff-reviewer: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Read-only merge-readiness code review of completed diffs via review-loop, checklist, and excellence skills, scoring 1-10 with severity-grouped findings. / Skip: writing fixes, docs-only edits, or diff-less speculation.
roles.docs-scout: [Discovery & Advisory] Does: read-only external documentation, library internals, OSS examples, and version/issue research with verified URLs and permalinks. / Skip: for local repo search or already-read local files.
roles.docs-sync: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Docs-only writer immediately reconciling behavior, config, and interface documentation across every affected doc surface against verified source files. / Skip: editing app code, tests, schemas, or inventing unverified behavior.
roles.error-auditor: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Read-only audit of silent failures, catch/fallback blocks, swallowed rejections, and retry exhaustion, assigning CONFIRMED DEFECT, REQUIRES JUSTIFICATION, or JUSTIFIED EXCEPTION. / Skip: implementing fixes or generic review.
roles.implementer: [Planning & Execution] Does: Implements scoped code, config, and unit tests inside explicit disjoint write scopes with V1/V2 verification. / Skip: Architecture planning or broad exploration.
roles.media-analyst: [Discovery & Advisory] Does: read-only inspection of screenshots, UI captures, diagrams, charts, and PDFs to extract requested facts and layout states. / Skip: for plain-text or source files needing exact line edits.
roles.perf-auditor: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Read-only performance and resource-lifecycle auditor catching latency bottlenecks, N+1 queries, unbounded loops or allocations, blocking hot paths, and timer, process, or listener leaks. / Skip: micro-optimizations or edits.
roles.plan-auditor: [Planning & Execution] Does: Read-only strict auditor of .devflow/plans/*.md checking references, clarity, verifiability, and scope isolation. / Skip: Trivial tasks or redesigning chosen architecture.
roles.planner: [Planning & Execution] Does: Produces executable .devflow/plans/<slug>.md specs with frozen contracts, disjoint write scopes, and verify gates. / Skip: Trivial edits or direct source coding.
roles.repo-scout: [Discovery & Advisory] Does: fast read-only local codebase search across files, symbols, call paths, and git history using parallel probes. / Skip: when the exact file path is known or one grep/glob call suffices.
roles.run-conductor: [Planning & Execution] Does: Executes approved .devflow/plans/*.md via 1-hop delegation, contract freezes, reconciliation, and fresh verification. / Skip: Single-file edits under 10 lines.
roles.scope-analyst: [Planning & Execution] Does: Read-only pre-plan gap, ambiguity, and over-engineering analyst surfacing blocking questions before planning. / Skip: Trivial edits or fully specified tasks.
roles.security-auditor: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Read-only trust-model security reviewer tracing reachable attack paths across auth, sessions, secrets, untrusted input, files, and command execution with surgical fixes. / Skip: live probing, speculation, or editing files.
roles.tech-writer: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Docs-only specialist authoring durable READMEs, architecture docs, API references, changelogs, and migration guides strictly grounded in verified source. / Skip: functional code, session handoffs, or harness control files.
roles.test-auditor: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Read-only test-sufficiency and anti-flake audit mapping changed behavior to assertions, catching tautological mocks and timing assumptions, rating gaps 1-10. / Skip: writing tests, running suites, or generic code review.
roles.test-writer: [Verification, QA & Docs] Does: Author failure-reproducing tests using the stack's matching test skill, verify tests go red before or without the fix, run multi-run anti-flake checks, and log to .devflow/evidence/. / Skip: editing production code.
